summary_en: M3 expanded its share buyback authorization from 20 million shares (200 billion yen) to 33.66 million shares (550 billion yen), representing 5.06% of outstanding shares. The company will conduct a tender offer at 1,619 yen per share targeting 30.88 million Sony Group shares, funded by 55 billion yen from the expanded frame.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Expansion of Acquisition Frame)
translation_en_brief:
On November 20, 2026, M3's board approved an expansion of its share buyback authorization originally announced on May 1, 2026. The acquisition frame has been expanded from 20 million shares (200 billion yen limit) to 33.66 million shares (550 billion yen limit), representing 5.06% of outstanding shares as of September 30, 2026. The expansion was driven by ongoing shareholder dialogue emphasizing enhanced capital efficiency, improved business performance, and current stock price levels.

The board also authorized a tender offer at 1,619 yen per share targeting a maximum 30.88 million shares from Sony Group, M3's largest shareholder with 230.46 million shares. Sony Group has indicated in writing its intention to tender 30.88 million shares at this price. The tender offer expenditure of approximately 55 billion yen will be funded from the expanded acquisition frame. Market purchases under the original authorization, which commenced August 25, 2026, will be suspended upon the tender offer completion, with no further buyback authorization increases planned as of November 20, 2026.
